assumptionsAndDecisions.statement: The all-skill requirement means every one of the 14 catalog skills is representable and covered by fixture assertions; only skills explicitly invoked in a run contribute progress.
assumptionsAndDecisions.rationale: Catalog definitions are not executed work, while every skill must have a valid invocation path.

assumptionsAndDecisions.statement: Use equal weights over eligible logical task leaves for the first aggregate implementation.
assumptionsAndDecisions.rationale: This is auditable and avoids unsupported effort estimates.

assumptionsAndDecisions.statement: Canonical persistence authority is normalized tables; the runs table stores metadata only, and all run snapshots are derived from child rows.
assumptionsAndDecisions.rationale: Removes duplicated payload/table sources of truth identified by review.

assumptionsAndDecisions.statement: Lifecycle transitions are explicitly allowed: not_started -> ready -> running; running -> succeeded|failed|blocked|cancelled; failed -> retrying|failed; retrying -> running; ready -> skipped; running -> indeterminate only when denominator becomes unknown; skipped/cancelled/failed/succeeded are terminal for an attempt, while a run is succeeded only when all required eligible leaves succeed.
assumptionsAndDecisions.rationale: Makes state behavior executable and prevents terminal-state ambiguity.

assumptionsAndDecisions.statement: Automated tests use Vitest with an npm test script; browser OPFS behavior remains a separate manual acceptance matrix.
assumptionsAndDecisions.rationale: The repository has no test runner, so test wiring is an explicit task rather than a non-runnable command.

design.domain: Separate CatalogSkill, TaskNode, SkillInvocation, Attempt, TelemetryEvent, and OrchestrationRun. Every entity has a stable run-scoped ID; invocation IDs are unique per occurrence; attempts belong to invocations; telemetry has event ID and sequence.
design.graph: Fixture contains all 14 skill definitions, one repeated skill invocation, a tools parent with two parallel leaves, and explicit eligible leaves. Catalog entries never enter the aggregate denominator unless represented by a task/invocation in the run graph.
design.state: Implement the allowed transition table in D1 as a pure transition guard. Terminal outcome projection is separate from completion: success requires all required eligible leaves succeeded; failed/blocked/cancelled remain unsuccessful; skipped has explicit eligibility semantics; unknown denominator yields indeterminate.
design.aggregate: Use eligible task leaves only: sum(weight * succeeded-or-declared-known-completion) / sum(weight). Parent, invocation, attempt, stage, and telemetry records are excluded from the denominator. Expose completion, success, failed, blocked, skipped, cancelled, indeterminate, and eventsObserved separately.
design.persistence: Make normalized SQLite tables canonical: schema_meta, runs metadata, tasks, skill_invocations, attempts, telemetry_events. Migrate prototype schema v1 to canonical v2 transactionally. Validate foreign/parent references, unique IDs/events, sequence ordering, and aggregate recomputation. Use BEGIN IMMEDIATE, expected previous version, same-version payload digest comparison, rollback, busy retry, and typed errors.
design.hydration: Persist active scenario ID and run identity. During client-only initialization, disable/queue controls until hydration resolves; database state wins over stale hash only when its run ID matches, otherwise create a new run and repair the hash. Cancel or ignore obsolete timers/saves by run/version token.
design.ui: Aggregate summary is primary; semantic task hierarchy includes parent and parallel leaves; invocation detail includes ID/task/state; attempt history includes number/state/checkpoint; telemetry count/trace is separate; stage strip remains. Use visible text, native progress where determinate, concise live status, focus-visible controls, reduced motion, and responsive layout.
design.testing: Vitest pure tests cover graph, transitions, selectors, retries, duplicate events, and all 14 skills. Adapter tests cover migrations, round trips, integrity, conflicts, busy/rollback, and fallback. Manual browser matrix covers Chromium current and Firefox current at 1440x900 and 375x812, reload/resume, two tabs, private mode, unsupported OPFS, quota/error simulation where feasible, keyboard, reduced motion, and screen-reader-oriented status.
